data.description:
Walking-skeleton steady-state runner. Creates reconcile-bridge.yml with cron schedule, GHA concurrency group, 15-min ceiling. Wires the Python entrypoint dso_reconciler for steady-state passes. IMPORTANT: must not be deployed until all four bootstrap bands are complete (operational dependency enforced via story depends_on).

## Done Definitions
- reconcile-bridge.yml runs on ~20-min cron, declares concurrency group reconcile-bridge with cancel-in-progress:false, times out at 15 minutes ← Satisfies: sc-2, sc-6
- Two simultaneous workflow dispatches result in exactly one running pass (second queued, not cancelled) ← Satisfies: sc-2
- A scheduled pass completes within the 15-min ceiling on converged state and exits 0 ← Satisfies: sc-2, sc-6

## Considerations
- [Reliability] cancel-in-progress:false is load-bearing — cancelling mid-write would corrupt the at-most-one invariant.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
data.title: As a bridge operator, I want the steady-state reconciler scheduled at ~20-min cadence with single-flight concurrency, so that drift heals continuously without manual intervention.
